thread:
Alex: Morning team — async standup for eng-security (quick): what I did / blockers / today. Finished Snyk fixes for service-proxy and added tests. Blocker: KMS rotation script failing in staging with "InvalidCipherText" on one mirrored key. Today: triage rotation + coordinate with infra. Ping @Sam if you have 30m.
Sam: on it, can join 11:30 PT. which key id?
Alex: key id `kms-prod-ax-3` (staging mirror). Error in logs: ```2028-03-10T09:12:34Z ERROR rotation failed key=kms-prod-ax-3 InvalidCipherText``` might be a policy or metadata mismatch.
Priya: ran an IAM audit — staging assume-role is missing `kms:Decrypt` for the rotation role. Opening a PR to patch.
Maria: deployed the Snyk patch, tests green :tada:. Can we do a smoke run after rotation?
Owen: FYI, the CI runner that does rotation dryruns OOM'd yesterday and was moved to r4. Reproducer for InvalidCipherText still shows up on the new runner.
Sam: I can dig into detailed logs after 11:30. also flagging scan backlog — suggest we triage all "high" severity alerts this sprint.
Alex: agreed. Priya + Maria, can you put together a short runbook for rotation failures: rollback steps, re-encrypt path, quick checks? Drop in the incident-runbooks repo and ping here.
Priya: will do, PR and runbook link coming shortly.
Maria: queuing post-rotation smoke tests: login flow, token mint, model-serving key decrypt.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: rotate-kms-staging v2028.03.10 at 09:50Z.
Alex: thanks — if rotation succeeds I'll mark Snyk fixes closed. if it fails I'll open a ticket and escalate to infra.
Sam: no other blockers from me.
Owen: one ask — can we add a console metric for "last successful kms-rotation" per environment? would help ops.
Alex: good idea, opening tracker ticket now.
Priya: PR #842 created to add kms:Decrypt to staging rotation role.
Maria: monitoring post-deploy, will report if smoke fails. :eyes:
Alex: cool, thanks everyone. end of async.
